description: Rep. John Bell, House majority leader, R-District 10, said Monday morning was a special occasion after many delays trying to get a historic preservation tax bill through the General Assembly. The bill delays the sunset of tax credits for rehabilitating income-producing and nonincome-producing historic structures for four years.“We’ve taken a lot of bumps and bruises to get here, but we are here,” Bell said.

title: $18M downtown historic project set to begin
